build_VectorQuantizer: build a VQ-VAE quantizer with n_e embeddings, e_dim dimensions, and a beta commitment loss coefficient
build_GumbelQuantize: build a Gumbel-Softmax quantizer with straight-through estimator, KL divergence weight, and temperature for reparameterizable discrete latents
build_VectorQuantizer2: build an improved VQ-VAE quantizer with optional index remapping, sane index shapes, and a legacy beta bug toggle
build_EMAVectorQuantizer: build an EMA-based vector quantizer that updates codebook embeddings via exponential moving average with configurable decay and epsilon
review_VectorQuantizer_forward: review the VectorQuantizer forward pass that maps continuous encoder output to discrete quantized latents using nearest-neighbor codebook lookup
